summary: Cenntro Inc. filed an 8-K on September 17, 2026, disclosing a private placement of common stock under Item 3.02. The company amended an August 25, 2026 securities purchase agreement on September 14, 2026, increasing the offering from 12,800,000 to 15,120,000 shares at $3.773 per share, the prior five-day Nasdaq average close, for gross proceeds of approximately $57,047,760. The placement closed September 15, 2026, with proceeds for working capital and general corporate purposes. Shares were sold to non-U.S. accredited investors under Regulation S/Section 4(a)(2).
